findings.evidence: The reader requires wait_and_reap_observed=True and exit_code=0 for the relation parent. The exact pinned launcher starts that parent with Popen(start_new_session=True), checks poll at launch and exits without waiting. The controller writes FAMILY_CLOSURE and returns; it cannot observe its own OS exit/reap and supplies no parent OS-exit receipt.
findings.impact: A complete successful family with exact parent absence/no CUDA and actual child exit receipts cannot honestly pass this parent predicate under the declared detached launch contract.
findings.minimal_V2_action: Use an explicit detached-parent evidence kind: bind exact LAUNCH/PARENT_OWNER/root release/controller source, full process identity including PID/start/session/argv, complete family/lane closures, and root observed parent absence/no CUDA. Keep direct wait false and unavailable OS exit null; do not infer exit 0 from closure. Preserve child direct wait/reap and successful EXIT requirements unchanged.
findings.title: Relation parent direct wait and exit evidence is required but the pinned launcher detaches the parent

findings.evidence: The reader is pinned to normal77 but historical() reruns original whole24 preflight against local PHASE paths and binds selected checkpoint/archive files locally. Root reports that normal77 has historical compact COLLECTION/COST and original12 union metadata, while the historical execution/checkpoint tree and six archives remain on the original allocation. This review did not access either route or confirm filesystem state independently.
findings.impact: Metadata staging alone does not make V1 runnable and does not establish current original checkpoint custody. The gate fails before alphaF collection when those required original files are absent.
findings.minimal_V2_action: Accept a hash-bound actual original-route custody attestation that preserves and verifies original whole24 source/role/endpoint/resource/failure/selected checkpoint, own-best-bank, terminal, extraction and completed collection/cost records. Bind original host/provider and exact reference metadata. Stage only the six prospectively fixed original archives server-only with unchanged hashes/sizes, retaining inherited original paths separately from staged paths. Verify all staged bytes before decoding; decode them only after all alphaF cohort seals. Do not reconstruct historical controls or substitute copied metadata for fresh original-route custody.
findings.title: Historical custody gate requires original historical trees locally on normal77

findings.evidence: The reader demands historical_prediction_collector.wait_and_reap_observed=True and exit_code=0, but the bound collector contract saves collection/cost status and does not supply its own external OS-exit receipt. The review did not read the actual historical launch receipt, so a detached historical launch is not independently established here.
findings.impact: If the actual historical collector was detached without an external waiter, this is the same unavailable-evidence blocker as R1. If a genuine direct wait/exit receipt exists, bind it explicitly rather than relying on an unbound boolean.
findings.minimal_V2_action: Resolve against exact original-route historical launch/supervision custody. Support only the evidence kind actually observed; a detached branch must retain unknown exit and no direct wait, while binding actual launch identity, exact release/collector source, complete historical collection/cost, absence/no CUDA and original-route authority. Original12 parent checks at readout_gate.py:80-88 already use identity plus absence/no CUDA without inventing direct waits.
findings.title: Historical collector also has an unconditional direct wait/exit predicate
